title: geomean
summary: Compute the geometric mean of numeric data.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until provider reduction hooks exist.

description: `geomean(X)` computes the geometric mean along the first non-singleton dimension. `geomean(X,dim)`, `geomean(X,vecdim)`, and `geomean(X,"all")` select the reduction axes.
behaviors: `"omitnan"` skips NaNs in each slice; empty slices return `NaN`.
Zero values produce a zero geometric mean for that slice.
Negative values produce `NaN` for the affected slice.

faqs.question: How do I ignore missing values?
